description: Shared enum definitions used only by Operations-domain components (never Investments or Dynamics). Domain-agnostic shared types remain in Core/common.json.

VSCACControlModes.description: AC-side control mode of a voltage-source-converter (VSC) terminal. AC_REACTIVE_POWER: converter controls reactive power / fixed power factor. AC_VOLTAGE: converter controls the AC-side voltage magnitude.
VSCACControlModes.title: VSCACControlModes

VSCDCControlModes.description: DC-side control mode of a VSC terminal. DC_POWER: controls active power to the DC side. DC_VOLTAGE: controls DC-side voltage. DC_VOLTAGE_DROOP: P-Vdc droop, V_dc = dc_setpoint - droop_gain * P_c.
VSCDCControlModes.title: VSCDCControlModes

FACTSControlDeviceControlMode.description: Operating mode of a FACTS control device. OOS: both series and shunt links open. NML: both links operating. BYP: series link bypassed as a zero-impedance line; shunt link operates as a reactive-only STATCOM.
FACTSControlDeviceControlMode.title: FACTSControlDeviceControlMode

SwitchedAdmittanceControlMode.description: Control mode of a switched shunt admittance. UNDEFINED: unspecified. FIXED: constant value. CONTINUOUS_VOLTAGE: adjusts continuously. DISCRETE_* modes switch blocks stepwise to control voltage, reactive power, or a remote bus's admittance.
SwitchedAdmittanceControlMode.title: SwitchedAdmittanceControlMode

CombinedCycleConfiguration.description: Shaft and turbine arrangement of a combined cycle plant: one shaft with one combustion and one steam turbine, separate shafts for the two, two or three combustion turbines feeding one steam turbine, or Other.
CombinedCycleConfiguration.title: CombinedCycleConfiguration

ReserveDirection.description: Direction a reserve product is procured in. UP increases generation or reduces load above expected demand. DOWN decreases generation or increases load below it. SYMMETRIC procures the same quantity both ways.
ReserveDirection.title: ReserveDirection

TransformerControlObjective.description: Control objective of a tap changer or phase shifter: FIXED (no adjustment), or regulation of voltage, reactive power, active power, asymmetric power, or a DC line. Each has a paired _DISABLED value; UNDEFINED means none stated.
TransformerControlObjective.title: TransformerControlObjective

TwoWindingTransformerShuntLocation.description: Placement of a TwoWindingTransformer's magnetizing shunt admittance. PRIMARY: applied on the primary side. SECONDARY: applied on the secondary side. SPLIT: applied on both sides.
TwoWindingTransformerShuntLocation.title: TwoWindingTransformerShuntLocation

ThreeWindingTransformerShuntLocation.description: Placement of a ThreeWindingTransformer's magnetizing shunt admittance. PRIMARY: applied on the winding-1 terminal side. STAR: applied at the star node.
ThreeWindingTransformerShuntLocation.title: ThreeWindingTransformerShuntLocation

VoltageUnitBasis.description: Unit basis a voltage setpoint is stored in. NATURAL_UNITS: kilovolts. COMPONENT_BASE: per-unit on the component's own base voltage. No separate system-base option.
VoltageUnitBasis.title: VoltageUnitBasis

LoadConformity.description: How a load tracks voltage and frequency variation in dynamic studies. CONFORMING responds predictably, following standard practice. NON_CONFORMING does not, e.g. a constant power load. UNDEFINED leaves it unstated.
LoadConformity.title: LoadConformity

OperationalStates.description: The on/off lifecycle of an in-service committable unit. OFFLINE: shut down. ONLINE: synchronized and producing. STARTUP/SHUTDOWN: mid-transition. Distinct from availability: an outaged unit has available = false regardless of state.
OperationalStates.title: OperationalStates

CommitmentModes.description: Why a committable unit is committed. UNCOMMITTED: not committed, available. COMMITTED: by the scheduling process. SELF_SCHEDULED: by its owner. RELIABILITY: by the system operator. MUST_RUN: required by contract or constraint.
CommitmentModes.title: CommitmentModes

BilateralProduct.description: Traded product of a bilateral transaction. ENERGY: energy. CAPACITY: capacity. ANCILLARY_SERVICE: an ancillary service. LOAD_OBLIGATION: a load obligation transfer.
BilateralProduct.title: BilateralProduct

MarketStage.description: Market stage a bilateral transaction was reported against. DAY_AHEAD: day-ahead. REAL_TIME: real-time.
MarketStage.title: MarketStage

BilateralConfirmation.description: Confirmation status a bilateral transaction settled under. DUAL_CONFIRM: both confirmed. UNILATERAL_BUYER/SELLER: only that side. FIRST_REPORTER_DEEMED: first-reported side deemed confirmed. EXACT_MATCH_OR_REJECT: exact match only.
BilateralConfirmation.title: BilateralConfirmation
